description: Read a tournament's activity log — the same audit trail the organizer console shows: event creation, roster changes, draw and schedule commits, score reports, corrections, undos and screen calls, newest first. Requires the tournament's manage_code (the log is organizer-only). Use it to answer 'what happened to this event' and to verify that writes actually landed. Read-only.

limit.description: Max entries to return, newest first (1-100)

name: get_activity_log
